description: This class represents a connection identifier within the Eclipse Ditto framework, providing methods for creating, validating, and handling connection IDs, including generating random IDs and a dummy ID.

classes.name: ConnectionId
classes.description: Immutable class representing a connection ID, with validation, equality, and utility methods.

methods.name: generateRandom
methods.description: Creates a new ConnectionId with a randomly generated UUID.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a ConnectionId from a CharSequence, returning the same instance if it is already a ConnectionId.

methods.name: dummy
methods.description: Returns a dummy ConnectionId instance that should not be used for actual connections.

methods.name: isDummy
methods.description: Checks whether this ConnectionId instance is the dummy ID.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Overrides Object.equals to compare ConnectionId instances based on their string representations.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Overrides Object.hashCode based on the string representation.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the ConnectionId.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the input string against the ID pattern, throwing an exception if invalid.
